principle: DO NOT SCALE. REFLOW. ONE RESPONSIVE SYSTEM, MANY PAGE EXPRESSIONS.

MOBILE.source: AIO_CLIENT_MIGRATION_AUTHORITY/ (41 phone authorities, 853×1536) — untouched; only breakpoint leakage may be repaired

authorities.note: The two responsive masters are archived here for validation; the authority directory was not modified. The masters draw mixed-case copy; the founder uppercase law overrides it.

files.page-type-taxonomy.json: 12 page types, density classes, default regions
files.screen-responsive-map.json: every screen: declaration + forensic audit + conformance (declaration fields generated from migrationResponsive.ts)
files.responsive-tokens.json: breakpoints, units, spacing tokens, content widths, typography roles, CTA rules
files.hero-rules.json: HERO_MODE, safe zones, plates, focal points
files.grid-rules.json: primary grid / process / support / form modes, review rules
files.future-page-contract.md: how a new page inherits the system
files.COMPOSER_PROPAGATION_MANIFEST.md: repetitive follow-up work, scoped for Composer
files.proof/: proof set A–G at mobile / tablet / desktop

implementation.shell: all-in-one-enterprises/src/client-migration/visual/AioMigrationKit.tsx (MigrationShell, AioMigrationEnvironment, AioMigrationHeader, AioDesktopSidebar, AioStaffDock, AioMigrationHero + HeroPlate, AioSteps)
implementation.modules: all-in-one-enterprises/src/client-migration/visual/AioMigrationModules.tsx (AioFlow = ContentGrid main/side, AioCard, AioRows, AioField, AioNote …)
css: aio-migration.css — phone authority renderer (representatives) + their tablet/desktop internals
aio-migration-flow.css — phone module renderer (propagated screens) + flow ≥700 / ≥1024
aio-migration-responsive.css — the blueprint: tokens, shell, hero band, root composition, page grammar

primitiveNames.SupportGrid: .amg-root support row (types / secure / what happens next) and the side column (SIDE)
primitiveNames.FooterAction: AioMigrationCTA (page action, rules in responsive-tokens.json › ctaRules)

actorShells.STAFF: AIO OFFICE — tablet: compact header + touch dock; desktop: AIO OFFICE / CLIENT MIGRATION header with search, persistent sidebar, no dock
actorShells.CLIENT: CLIENT OFFICE — no INTAKE, no staff sidebar, no dock, no staff controls; desktop content centred

header.MOBILE→TABLET: absolute authority header (98u / 88u) → 77px flex bar; workspace context (CLIENT MIGRATION / CLIENT ACTIVATION) after a divider; identity in a fixed slot
header.TABLET→DESKTOP: 68px utility bar; context gains AIO OFFICE / CLIENT OFFICE; search icon → search field (staff); a rule before the profile

nav.MOBILE→TABLET: authority dock → full-width 113px touch dock, five equal columns (staff only)
nav.TABLET→DESKTOP: dock removed; persistent 138px left sidebar HOME / INTAKE / FILING / REPORTS / MORE (staff only); clients get neither

hero.MOBILE→TABLET: authority lockup over the family plate → flowed band over the art-directed tablet plate (FULL 323px, COMPACT ≥ 250px); headline in the left 46%
hero.TABLET→DESKTOP: band inside the workspace (FULL 278px, COMPACT ≥ 232px), desktop plate, text inset 36px, left 44% safe zone

paths.MOBILE→TABLET: authority cards (absolute internals, two-line titles) → 3-up grid cards: strip, disc, one-line title, body, arrow bottom-right
paths.TABLET→DESKTOP: shorter cards (188px), arrow beside the copy, CARD_GAP 12px

process.MOBILE→TABLET: authority steps → horizontal band, equal columns from data, 46px dots
process.TABLET→DESKTOP: title + sub on one row, 34px dots, 32px inner padding

support.MOBILE→TABLET: providers panel + photo callout → 2-column support (file types tiles + secure)
support.TABLET→DESKTOP: 3-column support (+ what happens next); working screens: side column

forms.TABLET→DESKTOP: 2 columns in the main column beside the side panel

tables.MOBILE→TABLET: stacked rows → semantic table with a header row (TABLE)
tables.TABLET→DESKTOP: full main-column table with hover rows

reviews.TABLET→DESKTOP: staff: canvas + sticky context/actions panel; client: centred in the CLIENT OFFICE shell

ctas.MOBILE→TABLET: authority bar → one action as wide as the panels above it, 58px (founder note 2026-10-08; was centred ≤ 456px)
ctas.TABLET→DESKTOP: landing: workspace-wide bar; working screens: full width of the sticky side column

footers.MOBILE→TABLET: authority dock reserve → BOTTOM_SAFE_AREA = dock 113px + 22px (+ safe-area inset); clients 40px
footers.TABLET→DESKTOP: no dock: content ends 16px above the viewport bottom

images.MOBILE→TABLET: family plates → wide tablet plate (cover, focal 64–66%); path photos become 90px strips
images.TABLET→DESKTOP: desktop plate (truck fully framed); arrival keeps its full environment

typography.MOBILE→TABLET: authority units → px roles (1u ≈ 1px for panels; hero 73px FULL / 46px COMPACT)
typography.TABLET→DESKTOP: hero 72 / 52px, step labels 14px tracked, sidebar labels 13.5px

spacing.MOBILE→TABLET: authority coordinates → tokens (gutter 16, section 12, grid 11, card gap 8)
spacing.TABLET→DESKTOP: section 11, grid 10, card gap 12; content measure caps at 1480px (staff) / 1240px (client) / 940px (arrival)

validation.rootComposition: element-box IoU (4px tolerance) vs the masters at the master viewport — target ≥ 90
validation.descendants: RESPONSIVE_SYSTEM_CONFORMANCE 0–100 (shell 20 · hero 15 · grid 15 · overflow 15 · gutters 10 · CTA 10 · table 5 · touch 10), mean of tablet and desktop — not a pixel match
validation.mobileRegression: every screen's phone capture vs the pre-sprint commit (pixel diff, threshold 0.01%)
